sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the three revelations of Memaleh, Sovev, and Atzmus Ein Sof correspond to three times and also to the three worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah, showing that even within the world of Asiyah these three aspects exist.

translations.translation: And it may be said,
that among the reasons for this that the maamar brings
(brought above in section 4)

from the verse "He will revive us after two days, on the third day..." and explains that the two days are the two revelations of Memaleh and Sovev, and the third day is the revelation of Atzmus Ein Sof,
and these three revelations are revealed in three times,
it is to hint,
that although time is a boundary of the world76
and the vitality of the world
(which is clothed within it in its inwardness)
is Memaleh,
nevertheless,
the world is also related to Sovev and also to Ein Sof which is above Sovev.
And to note,
that similarly, regarding place
[for the boundary of the world is place and time76],
the matter of place in the world is that there are in it different levels of above and below84,
for although the division of above and below in the world is due to the difference in the vitality clothed within it,
Memaleh
[as our sages said85
He extended His right and created the heavens, He extended His left and created the earth,
for the heavens
(the upper worlds)
are from the aspect of right and the earth
(the lower worlds)
are from the aspect of left,
and the distinction of right and left is in the vitality of the aspect of Memaleh as explained in the continuation of the Hilula86
and is also understood simply],
nevertheless,
all the worlds collectively are divided into three worlds: Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah87,
which are analogous to the three revelations mentioned above.
And as explained in many places88,
that matter
(Beriah),
the essence of existence which is above form and revelation,
is analogous to the essential concealment of Atzmus Ein Sof,
and form
(Yetzirah),
the revelation of matter,
is analogous to Sovev which is the revelation of Atzmus Ein Sof,
and refinement
(Asiyah),
particular depiction,
is analogous to Memaleh which is clothed in every world and every created being according to its worth.
And this is also what is said in the maamar89
in the explanation of the wording of the blessing "Borei Nefashot",
that "their lack" in the plural refers to the two matters of filling the lack from the aspect of Memaleh Kol Almin and Sovev Kol Almin,
and "for all that You created to enliven with them",
which the Tur90 explains
are things that come for refinement and pleasure,
this is the matter of the abundance of wealth from the aspect of the revelation of Atzmus Ein Sof,
and it may be said,
that among the reasons that the maamar brings this explanation,
it is to hint,
that even in the world of Asiyah
(including also this physical world)
there exist these three matters.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the Divine vitality of Memaleh is revealed in the world through the service of Israel, while the drawing down of Sovev and Ein Sof will be revealed in the future, in the days of Moshiach and the Resurrection of the Dead.

translations.translation: However, the Divine vitality that is clothed in the world
(Memaleh)
is in revelation in the world,
and that even the revelation of this vitality is through the service of Israel
[and as explained in the discourse "Zot Chukat HaTorah"91
that the revelation of the three matters of Memaleh, Sovev, and Atzmus Ein Sof is through the three loves of "with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might"],
it is,
for this that the vitality of Memaleh is in revelation in the world is that in the world it is felt that it is alive,
but it is not felt in it that the vitality within it is Divinity,
and through the service of Israel it is felt in the world that the vitality within it is Divinity.
And this revelation is also now,
in this world.
And the vitality of Sovev which is not clothed in the world and only surrounds and encompasses it,
and all the more so Ein Sof which is above Sovev — their drawing down into the world is through the service of Israel,
and the revelation of these drawings down will be in the future,
in the days of Moshiach
(the revelation of Sovev)
and the Resurrection of the Dead
(the revelation of Atzmus Ein Sof which is above Sovev),
as above
(section 4).

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Moshe is called "wealthy" because he is the aspect of the upper Da'at, which receives from the innerness of the Keter (Atik), the aspect of Atzmus Ein Sof, which is the true source of wealth.

translations.translation: And the maamar explains92,
that this that Moshe is called wealthy
[and as above in section 3 that "prayer of Moshe" is the prayer of a wealthy man]
is because Moshe is the aspect of upper Da'at.
And the matter is,
that lower Da'at receives from the externality of Keter,
Arich,
and upper Da'at receives from the innerness of Keter,
Atik.
And the difference between Arich and Atik is,
that Arich is the root and source of the emanated beings,
the aspect of Sovev
[and as above in section 4 that Sovev is like a source for the worlds],
and Atik is the lower level within the Emanator,
Atzmus Ein Sof which is above the category of worlds.
And since the revelation of Sovev
(Arich)
is included in the filling of the lack, and the matter of wealth is specifically in Atzmus Ein Sof which is above Sovev
(Atik),
therefore,
also in Da'at,
the matter of wealth is specifically in upper Da'at which receives from the innerness of Keter.
